gods/innos.intro: thumb|right|A shrine dedicated to Innos in [[Gothic 3]] Innos is one of the three major gods of the Gothic series.  Innos is the god of order, fire and light.  He is in opposition to his brother Beliar, while the third brother Adanos keeps the balance between Innos and Beliar.

gods/beliar.intro: thumb|right|A shrine dedicated to BeliarBeliar is one of the three major gods of the Gothic series.  · He is the god of the night and death.  He is in an eternal battle with Innos, in which Adanos tries to keep the balance between the two.

gods/adanos.intro: thumb|right|Symbol of Adanos Adanos is the god of water, nature and balance.  He encourages work, learning and knowledge.  He keeps the balance between his brothers Innos and Beliar in the world.

regions/old-camp.intro: The Old Camp is one of the main three camps in the Colony.  Gomez and the Ore Barons are its rulers.  The Old Camp is the oldest and by far the richest camp established by the convicts in the Valley of Mines.

facts.label: Inhabitants
facts.value: Ore Barons · Magicians of Fire · Guards · Shadows · Diggers

facts.label: Notable spots
facts.value: Castle · Ore Barons' Residence · Fire Mage's Residence · Market

regions/new-camp.intro: New Camp is one of the three camps in the penal colony of Khorinis in Gothic and Gothic Remake.  It is a camp of people wanting to leave the colony.  It is conjointly ruled by the Water mages, Lee and Lares.

regions/swamp-camp.intro: (also know as Sect Camp, Brotherhood, Loonies) is one of the three camps in the penal colony of Khorinis in Gothic and Gothic Remake.  It is ruled by gurus - spiritual leaders - with Y (read as "ee") as the head.  Last known head of the gurus is Y'Berion.

regions/valley-of-mines.intro: (also known as: Ger.  Minental) is a region of Khorinis where magic ore was being extracted by humans for use in the orc war.

regions/exchange.intro: 350px|thumb|right Exchange Place is a location in Gothic.  It is used for exchanging goods between the Colony and the outside world.  This is where you meet Diego at the start of the game.

regions/old-mine.intro: Old Mine is a mine in Gothic, Gothic II, Gothic II: Night of the Raven and Gothic Remake.

regions/free-mine.intro: is a mine under control of the New Camp in Gothic and Gothic Remake.

regions/mountain-fort.intro: Mountain Fort, also known as Mountain Fortress is a location in Gothic and Gothic II, situated in the south of the Valley of Mines.  A former place for a focus stone, it becomes a lair for the rock dragon Pedrakhan.

regions/temple-of-the-magicians-of-fire.wikiTitle: Temple of the Magicians of Fire
regions/temple-of-the-magicians-of-fire.intro: |Tab2Name = Gothic II |Tab2 = }} Temple of the Magicians of Fire, also known as Temple of the Fire Mages or Chapel is a building inside the Old Camp's castle.  It serves as a home to Fire mages.

facts.label: Name
facts.value: Temple of the Magicians of Fire

characters/gomez.intro: Gomez is the ruler of the Old Camp.

characters/scatty.intro: }}Scatty runs the arena of the Old Camp.

characters/corristo.intro: }} Corristo is the leader of the Magicians of Fire in the Old Camp.  He participated in the creation of the magical Barrier of Khorinis, which ended up imprisoning him along with the other convicts and magicians.

characters/whistler.intro: }}Whistler is a Shadow of the Old Camp.

characters/fingers.intro: }}Fingers is a Shadow and the most skillful thief of the Old Camp.  He can be found near the castle wall when going left facing the castle entrance.

characters/raven.intro: Raven is an Ore Baron of the Old Camp in Gothic and the eponymous antagonist of the expansion Gothic II: Night of the Raven.

characters/guy.intro: Guy is a Digger from the Old Camp.

characters/lee.intro: |Image = . png |Guild = Mercenary |Level = 19 |Teaches = Two-handed, Strength, Dexterity |Location = New Camp |Weapons = Lee's Axe |Armor = Heavy Mercenary's Armor |Status = Alive |Insert Code = SLD_700_Lee |Voice Actor = Ray Shell }} }} is the leader of the Mercenaries of the New Camp.

characters/lares.intro: }}Lares is the leader of the Rogues of the New Camp.  After the fall of the Barrier of Khorinis he joins the Mercenaries and the Ring of Water.

characters/cord.intro: is a Mercenary of the New Camp.

characters/saturas.intro: is the leader of the Water Mages of the New Camp.

characters/cavalorn.intro: |Tab2Name = Gothic 2 NotR |Tab2 = }} Cavalorn is a hunter from the Old Camp.

characters/cor-kalom.intro: Cor Kalom is a Guru of the Swamp Camp.  He and Cor Angar are the most powerful people in the camp besides Y'Berion.

facts.label: Weapons
facts.value: Kalom's Sword · Default: Sleep · End fight: Pyrokinesis ·

characters/baal-parvez.intro: Baal Parvez is a Novice of the Swamp Camp recruiting new members in the Old Camp's marketplace.

characters/xardas.intro: |Tab2Name = Gothic II |Tab2 = |Tab3Name = Gothic 3 |Tab3 = |Tab4Name = G3: TB |Tab4 = |Tab5Name = ArcaniA |Tab5 = }} Xardas is an important character appearing in every installment of Gothic series.  A former High Magician of Fire, he becomes a Necromancer and leaves the Old Camp to study dark arts.  He becomes a mentor for the Nameless Hero and helps him to regain the world's balance, while pursuing his own goals.

characters/gorn.intro: Gorn is a key character from the Gothic series and one of the Four Friends.

characters/milten.intro: Milten is an important character appearing in every installment of Gothic series, except Gothic 3: The Beginning.  He was sent to the colony together with Diego, Gorn and Lester and later becomes a fire mage of the Old Camp.  One of the Four Friends, he supports Nameless Hero throughout his journey.

characters/lester.intro: Lester is a character from Gothic, Gothic II, Gothic 3, ArcaniA and ArcaniA: Fall of Setarrif.  He is one of the Nameless Hero's best friends with a passion for Swampweed.

characters/ian.intro: Ian is a character from Gothic, and a boss of the Old Mine.
